sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the existing navigating-in-ice applicability, ballast-tank conditional, ship ownership, units, direct-calculation formula, and inclusive comparisons. Repair UIWL selection: the forward-draught query still uses ship-level displacementAtUpperIceWaterline without associating it with each hasUpperIceWaterline node, so it cannot select the displacement corresponding to the greatest-displacement UIWL. Use the supplied canonical waterlineDisplacement on each UIWL, pair it through hasUpperIceWaterline, select the greatest displacement with bounded logic, and use the corresponding declared ship-owned displacementAtUpperIceWaterline as the formula operand; do not place that ship-owned property on an iceWaterline node.
